description: This file defines the 'DishIngredient' result class for the Coocook schema, representing ingredients associated with dishes, including methods for managing purchase list associations and editing.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::DishIngredient
classes.description: A schema result class representing an ingredient in a dish, with associations to articles, units, and items, and methods for purchase list management and editing.

methods.name: assign_to_purchase_list
methods.description: Associates the dish ingredient with a purchase list by creating or retrieving an item and linking it.

methods.name: update_on_purchase_list
methods.description: Updates the associated item from the ingredient's data if the item exists.

methods.name: remove_from_purchase_list
methods.description: Removes the ingredient from the purchase list, deleting the item if it is not associated with other ingredients.

methods.name: for_ingredients_editor
methods.description: Prepares a data structure for editing the ingredient, including available units and current details.
